--- POLICY_LEDGER_CONTEXT ---
- Kept AHSOKA_PHONEME_OVERRIDES={} and the Markdown/TTS markup sanitizer.
- Restored the last measured fan-fiction acoustic profile:
  max phoneme IDs 240; length scale 1.28; noise scale 0.667; noise_w 0.68; phrase pause 0.10 s; paragraph pause 0.22 s; edge fade 0.008 s; volume 1.10.
- Bumped the Ahsoka local-ready marker to v2 so previously cached/local-active state is ignored after the next client reload. This deliberately returns Ahsoka to the verified server/Piper baseline until Test voice explicitly re-enables local WASM inference.
- Ahsoka direct regression remains HTTP 200 / X-TTS-Provider=piper.

Client Audio panel:
- pwa-voice-bridge v1.1.7.
- Piper worker v0.1.1.
- Panel title changed from Client voice to Voice route because Cortana is server-backed.
- Test local renamed Test voice.
- Opening the panel remains passive; no model/GPU probe is required.
- Cortana Test voice performs only a lightweight server/Pocket health/warm check.
- Ahsoka local inference is WASM-safe; worker also includes execution-time WebGPU->WASM recovery for INT64 GatherND failures.
- External HTTPS serving verified for bridge v1.1.7, worker v0.1.1 and loader; package/frontend static copies are synchronized.

Memory recovery:
- Primary voice server changed to lazy-load Kokoro and legacy RVC dependencies. Only Ahsoka/Piper is kept hot.
- Removed top-level Kokoro, scipy-signal, soundfile and legacy RVC runtime imports from the hot path; they load only if actually needed.
- Primary voice RSS dropped from ~3.87 GB to ~136 MB after restart.
- Host available memory rose from ~2.8 GB to ~6.9 GB immediately after the voice cleanup; with two small Ollama models resident it remains ~5.2 GB available.

Ollama:
- OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE increased 10m -> 30m.
- OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS increased 1 -> 2.
- NUM_PARALLEL remains 1 and context remains 4096.
- Verified gemma3:270m and gemma3:1b can coexist resident.
- gemma3:270m cold: load ~4.003 s, total ~4.059 s.
- gemma3:270m warm after hot-set retention: load ~0.0014 s, total ~0.0618 s.
- gemma3:1b cold: load ~11.521 s, total ~11.799 s.
- This confirms the perceived wait is cold model I/O/loading, not inference latency.

Final hashes:
- kokoro-openai-server.py 6ce44a43b9c67d9a73e58add83a8b123caee0bedec986030ce97d798dd7c0adb
- pwa-voice-bridge.js 85fbbb7fa1b7a194cde0f6f5f774f11d0a927e47f2ff8332931115789b2f9674
- piper-core.worker.mjs f0768058ec2bcce992113f5f00f90b075b7d53e0ab5a3fba17cd78624d7a5b10
- loader.js de704c5d68e5f0fb756968119628f08b456b1479c64adec9e055149dcade414b
- ollama-runtime.env bd3dc41e5f4b26d72a280afc1f7a59376883de464e7f7d6cd0748b07bed28734

Rollback:
- kokoro-openai-server.py.pre-resource-recovery-gpt56sol.bak
- pwa-voice-bridge.js.pre-resource-recovery-gpt56sol.bak
- ollama-runtime.env.pre-hotset-gpt56sol.bak

## 2026-09-26 — Cortana RVC fully retired
Attribution: GPT-5.6 Sol.

User decision:
- Cortana RVC never worked in the actual user path and is not to remain as a fallback or candidate. Remove it completely from the active architecture.
